additionalGames.title: Wacky Races
additionalGames.group: Additional test outside the original 239-game catalog
additionalGames.notes: Boot code runs and GD-ROM sectors are read, but no image, logos, cinematics or menu are displayed. SH-4 aborts on invalid odd target 0xE2010009. Initial AOT reports 856 reachable functions; subsequent run activated two dynamic AOT patch DLLs (13+10 native blocks), without reaching a visible boot checkpoint. Not Ingame-Crash: gameplay never starts. Based on user confirmation and session logs from 2026-10-12.

additionalGames.title: Sonic Adventure
additionalGames.group: Additional test outside the original 239-game catalog
additionalGames.notes: Compilation blocked before runtime testing: MSVC cl.exe ran out of memory while compiling very large generated C++/SH-4 AOT source parts. No successful executable run, boot, graphics, menu or gameplay verified. This is a build/compiler blocker, NOT an observed game boot failure. User reconfirmed no successful run on 2026-10-12.
